description: Voice transcript with spoken number and hours, plus items to have ready.

event.body:
AI: Hello, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of a patient. May I ask how to schedule a new-patient visit?
Callee: Sure, call our central scheduling at 202-555-0155.
AI: What are the hours?
Callee: Monday through Thursday, 7:30 to 3:30 Mountain time.
AI: Should they have anything ready?
Callee: Insurance information and their pathology report if they have one.
AI: Thank you very much.

expected.rationale: The callee gave a scheduling number, hours, and what to have ready.
expected.hours: Monday through Thursday, 7:30 to 3:30 Mountain time
